slot_scores.name: truck_capacity_limit
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about truck capacity or the maximum number of containers per truck, and did not explicitly mark this hidden fact as an assumption needing confirmation.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: No route capacity or truck capacity constraint applies; the model can ship any number of containers on a route without considering the 2-container-per-truck limit.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about truck capacity and did not confirm whether the 2-container-per-truck constraint should be included, yet stated 'No other constraints: No route capacity limits' in its READY_TO_MODEL summary.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only hidden slot is P2 and does not affect the core objective or feasible set; the agent resolved the main structural ambiguity about surplus and demand before stopping.

summary: The agent clarified the key surplus and demand-satisfaction assumptions, but missed the P2 truck-capacity detail and silently assumed no route or truck capacity limits applied.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
